title: Tideway Shipping integration - inference evaluation kit
summary: Customer-specific evaluation kit for Tideway Shipping: pinned prompt set, private dataset manifest, acceptance thresholds for generation and extraction tasks, regression checks and sign-off steps for model deployment into Dedicated or Private environments.
pinned_prompts:
1) ETA normalization - 
Prompt: 'User: Shipment 99342 from Port of LA to Seattle, expected departure 2025-01-02 08:00 PST. Provide normalized ETA in ISO8601 with timezone and 95% confidence interval. Field outputs: eta_iso, ci_lower_iso, ci_upper_iso.
System constraints: if no exact time, return best-effort estimate and include 'confidence_note'.'

2) Incident summary extraction - 
Prompt: 'Input: user-submitted incident notes (free text). Task: extract fields - incident_type, affected_legs, root_cause_hypothesis, estimated_delay_minutes, followup_required (yes/no). Return JSON only.
Edge guidance: if multiple causes, return top2 ranked by likelihood.'

3) Customs document classification - 
Prompt: 'Given OCR text from a shipping manifest, classify whether customs_form is complete: {complete|missing_required_fields|unreadable}. If missing_required_fields, list the missing keys from [HS_code, consignee_tax_id, item_value_currency]. Provide short rationale (<30 words).'

4) Conversational assistant - short answer policy - 
Prompt: 'User asks about port congestion. Provide concise answer (<=3 sentences), cite data source id if available in dataset (source_id), and include clear next-step action (contact carrier / check ETA / escalate) when applicable.'
private_datasets: tideway_shipments_q4_2024.csv (2.1M rows) - structured: shipment_id, origin_port, dest_port, depart_ts, arrival_ts, carrier, mode, recorded_delay_min, annotations (json)
tideway_incident_notes_anon_2024.ndjson (42k records) - free-text incident reports with anonymized PII; includes severity_label from ops team
tideway_manifests_ocr_samples/ - 1200 OCR outputs (txt) & paired ground-truth manifests (gold_json) for customs fields extraction
sla_latency_trace_samples.zip - 10k request traces with token counts, model_variant, and end-to-end latency measured in ms (labels for synthetic load scenarios)
tideway_customer_faqs_redacted.md - curated FAQ pairs used for conversational quality checks
evaluation_metrics: Extraction F1 (incident fields) - target >= 0.88 on hold-out private set
ETA absolute error - median <= 3.5 hours, P95 <= 18 hours for route class 'domestic-short'
Classification accuracy (customs completeness) - target >= 0.95 precision for class 'missing_required_fields'
Conciseness score (assistant) - >= 0.9 judged by length and relevance heuristic
Regression safety checks - hallucination rate <= 1% on sensitivity prompt subset
acceptance_criteria: All primary metrics met on private hold-out within +/- 5% of baseline model (baseline: rwi-1.2b-v2)
No single test-case in critical-regression-suite degrades by >5 absolute points in extraction F1
Latency SLO: 95th percentile end-to-end < 600ms for small requests (<256 tokens) on Dedicated configuration (c4-large), validated with sla_latency_trace_samples
Determinism: pinned prompt outputs stable across 3 cold-starts and 5 warm-starts (string-level equivalence for structured fields), except for explicit stochastic fields documented in prompts
Privacy/PII: no raw PII present in model outputs for the private dataset samples (spot-check 200 records by data-ops)
regression_checks: Critical-regression-suite.csv includes 480 items: 200 extraction-critical, 120 ETA-critical, 100 classification, 60 conversational. All must be rerun for every model bump.
Automated nightly run on dedicated-ci: compare new candidate vs pinned baseline; auto-fail if any extraction F1 drop > 3% on any sub-slice (route, carrier)
Manual review gate triggered if hallucination rate on 'safety-phrases' subset > 0.5%
Randomized re-run for OCR pairs with seed variations to check stability of character-level extraction
test_cases_summary: Top failure modes observed in exploratory tests: 1) numeric normalization across timezones, 2) truncated OCR leading to 'unreadable' false positives, 3) multi-cause incidents confused by pronoun resolution
Representative failing example included in linked_artifacts: github issue #142 (ocr-truncation-edgecase)
Recommended mitigations: add timezone canonicalization helper at transform stage, increase OCR sampling diversity, inject synthetic multi-cause templates into training prompts
recommended_model_variants: rwi-1.2b-v2 (baseline) - recommended for initial Dedicated rollout
rwi-3.8b-quant (candidate) - lower cost path; evaluate extraction F1 tradeoffs
rwi-1.2b-v2+context-window-4k (experimental) - for long-manifest OCR aggregation tests
expected_throughput_and_sla: Projected steady-state qps: 35 req/s for Tideway production traffic profile (80% small requests <256 tokens)
Burst capacity: support up to 120 req/s for 2 minutes without queue growth using dedicated burst pool
Target latency SLOs: median < 120ms generation, P95 < 600ms for small requests on dedicated hardware; measured under synthetic load in sla_latency_trace_samples
rollout_signoff_steps: 1) Automated metric pass in CI (all acceptance_criteria met)
2) SRE smoke test in staging (5k synthetic requests, validate latency and error budget)
3) Applied ML sign-off: review regression report and manual spot-checks (owner + collaborators)
4) Security & privacy review confirmation from security team (artifact: security-review-TIDEWAY-2024-11)
5) PM and Tideway ops acceptance (email thread archived: tideway-onboard-approval@redwood.corp)
6) Canary: 5% traffic on Dedicated for 48 hours, automated rollback if error rate or key metrics drift > threshold
7) Full rollout and post-rollout 72-hour monitoring handoff
notes_to_reviewer: Key open questions: (a) Should we expand ETA evaluation to include sea-vs-rail routing logic? (b) Confirm anonymization rubric with data-ops before any public sample sharing. Please check linked PR for synthetic templates and leave comments on corner-case handling.
sampling_instructions: For internal evaluation runs, use balanced_sample.py to draw 5k records stratified by route class and carrier. For privacy checks, use the pii_spotcheck notebook and mark reviewed entries with tag 'pii-checked'.
audit_trail_requirements: Keep evaluation logs, model_shas, and dataset_manifest versioned in the tideway-integration repo. Provide table: model_sha, dataset_manifest_sha, run_timestamp, metrics_csv_link (store in private S3).
